name: browser-cleanup-01
purpose: C014 cleanup proof for the real isolated headless Edge (self-review line 9): tests\browser.cjs is run as a child with C014_BROWSER_INJECT_FAILURE=1, which fails an assertion right after the real session opened; the child must exit 1 with the injected message and its finally block must have closed the session (the page reports itself closed). The injected failure is the expected result, the proof script exits 0.
